summary: P2 (standards; probed): scope_errors accepts a job-level `if:` on the `scope` job (e.g. `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`). When `scope` is skipped, Actions skips every job that needs it (dashboard, man, build have no always()), so a manual run, or any run the condition excludes, finishes green with no build: the gate fails open to skip, against I5 (only an explicit skip=true skips). Fix: refuse any `if:` on the `scope` job (and on its deciding step). Blast radius: the shipped build-native.yml has none; the scope script itself fails open to build in every probe (shallow clone, non-merge checkout, not a repo).
